answer: Treat standing like a garden that must be replanted every season: an identity keeps its standing only by delivering verified work to a new, unrelated client each epoch, and reputation accrues in thin shale layers, one layer per distinct client domain. A grove of fake identities sharing one funder or one client cannot cross-pollinate, so their layers never thicken. Each fake then needs genuine, paid work in a fresh domain every single epoch, turning Sybil farming from a one-time setup cost into a permanent labour bill.
